title: Visible Totems
description: This texture pack makes your totems visible in your inventory like never before!

## Description
Red Totems. See It. Pop It. Survive.
Ever died because you couldn't spot your Totem of Undying in a cluttered hotbar or inventory during a chaotic fight? Red Totems fix that.
This pack recolors the Totem of Undying a bold, unmistakable red, so it stands out instantly against the default gold-and-white clutter of your inventory, hotbar, and offhand slot. Lightweight, simple, and laser focused on doing one thing exceptionally well: keeping you alive.

## Why Red?
Faster totem swaps — your eyes lock onto red much faster than gold in a busy UI.
Built for PvP & high-risk content — Wardens, raids, nether fights, you name it.
Reduces visual noise — no more mistaking your totem for other gold items.
Trains muscle memory — consistent color cues mean faster, more confident plays.
No more squinting. No more fumbling. Just instant recognition — and instant reaction.

## Perfect For:
PvP players who need split-second totem pops like for Crystal PvP.
Survival players tackling high-stakes bosses.
Anyone who's ever panicked (and/or died) searching their hotbar or inventory mid-fight for an almost invisible totem.
